New

Cookie Info & Loading
Tonight, Cookies and ghosts are all friends! Do you think the pumpkin full moon tastes pumpkin-y? Just wondering...
Beep beep! Full moon means everyone at Pumpkin Square, pronto! Tonight's the night when anything goes, seriously!
Beep beep! Costumes are a must at this party, got it? I'm on the hunt for the biggest pumpkin ever for our yard!
Hehe! Trick or treat! I can't wait for it to get dark so the jack-o'-lanterns light up!
Parties are all about laughing, chatting and stuffing our faces! Beep beep! Let's keep it orderly, everyone! Straight lines, please!
Tired

Lobby

Daily Reward
Wouldn't it be awesome if every day was party day?
Tap
I'm gonna hand out candies with cute little notes! How cool is that? Sometimes I wonder what kind of parties do other villages throw?
Beep beep! You don't know anything about this party, do you? I organize my candy by flavor and type. Doesn't everyone?
Trust me! I know best about Night of the Pumpkin Moon parties! Stick to the rules and this party will be off the charts!
Beep beep! Party's over? Time to plan next year's! Got this whistle as a gift in case I get lost!
It's not just a one-day party. It's epic BECAUSE it only one day! I wrote down ALL the party rules! It's practically a novel!

 Star Voyage Guide

General

Cookie Info & Loading
I hope everyone sleeps soon so we get dream voyagers! Just close your eyes and imagine... Then a ticket is yours!
Beep beep! Look outside! It's a meteor shower! This is the sparkling Milky Way Station! Isn't it beautiful?! Hehe!
Beep beep! We'll be departing soon! Take your seats! Our next stop? Hehe, it's up to your imagination!
Today's snack is a Stardust Pumpkin Pie! Yummy! Hehe, I won't play tricks if you give me a treat!
Beep beep! Please stand in neat, orderly lines! You never know what might happen on a voyage like this!

Not enough imagination...

Beep beep! Double-check your belongings before you disembark! Ssh, be quiet in the sleeping cars! You might wake up the sleeping dream voyagers!
Your seat is... huh? There's no seat number! Well... Just imagine one up! Hehe, the passengers all said they enjoyed the trip... I did a good job, right?

Beep beep! All aboard! Hehe, you should sit in the window seat and enjoy the views!
Bet you've never seen the night sky so close! Hehe. We could almost touch the Pumpkin Moon! When we stop at Milky Way Station let's all dip our dough in the Milky Way before we set off again!
